includes: Rod, reel, tackle, bait, fish cleaning, filleting, and packaging included with fishing charters
blurb: Guests can enjoy private charters on a 28' Long Cabin boat equipped with fishing gear, heated cabin, and private restroom. Fishing charters target salmon, rockfish, ling cod, Dungeness crab, halibut, tuna, and Humboldt squid. Whale watching charters run 2-3 hours to see grey whales, orcas, humpbacks, and blue whales seasonally. Ash scattering services provide a meaningful sea ceremony for up to 6 passengers.
extraNote: Cancellation must be received at least 7 days in advance or 50% fee charged; within 48 hours full cost charged; no charge if operator cancels due to weather or unforeseen circumstances · Bodega Bay Dock Location at 1500 Bay Flat Road, Bodega Bay, CA
